sources.title: An Empirical Study of Gendered Stereotypes in Emotional Attributes for ...
sources.snippet: Many studies on bias in LLMs focus on gender bias in various NLP applications. However, there's a gap in research on bias in emotional attributes, despite the close societal link between emotion and gender. This gap is even larger for low-resource languages like Bangla.

sources.title: Bangla Emotion Bias
sources.snippet: This study mainly focuses on showing the existence of gender bias in the context of emotions in Bangla through analytical methods and also show how emotion attribution changes on the basis of gendered role selection in LLMs.
